name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
summary: In Valanaar on Zephras Isle, Ayessa Dawnsinger guides the Horde aligned Skyborne. She leads the Windshapers through their trials and politics.

sections.title: Leader of the Windshapers
sections.body: From Valanaar on Zephras Isle, Ayessa Dawnsinger leads the Windshapers, the Skyborne aligned with the Horde. She directs their efforts across the island as they face outside threats and divisions among themselves. She guides them through alliances in Kalimdor and beyond, with their survival at stake.

sections.title: The Struggle for Zephras
sections.body: Ayessa Dawnsinger sends trusted champions to resolve conflicts on Zephras Isle. They face rogue constructs and hostile figures such as Lorthuna while the Skyborne confront their fate. Through political and physical struggles, Ayessa guides the Windshapers and keeps their voice and strength respected within the Horde.

faq.answer: Ayessa Dawnsinger leads the Windshapers, the Horde aligned Skyborne on Zephras Isle.

faq.q: Where can Ayessa Dawnsinger be found?
faq.answer: Ayessa Dawnsinger can be found in Valanaar on Zephras Isle.
The Windshapers are the Skyborne faction aligned with the Horde. Ayessa Dawnsinger guides them from Valanaar.

faq.q: What is Ayessa's role in local quests?
faq.answer: Ayessa Dawnsinger gives work concerning the island's defense, including investigating rogue constructs, confronting Lorthuna, and shaping Zephras's future.

angles.text: For the Horde, Ayessa Dawnsinger is a key Skyborne ally and a point of contact on Zephras Isle.
As a Skyborne, you can see in Ayessa Dawnsinger the path of those who stand with the Horde to secure their future.
